body:
## Summary

A downstream Sepo install hit a self-approval dead-end because `agent-self-approve.yml` runs the ACPX agent with `permission_mode: approve-reads`, while the self-approval prompt requires independent PR investigation via terminal commands such as:

- `gh pr view <pr> --repo <repo> ...`
- `gh pr diff <pr> --repo <repo>`
- occasionally `git fetch` to inspect the PR head

With `approve-reads`, the runner/ACPX tool permission system refused these commands. The self-approval agent correctly returned `BLOCKED` instead of approving without concrete evidence.

Observed on downstream PR: self-evolving/benchmark-frontier-cs#7
Run: https://github.com/self-evolving/benchmark-frontier-cs/actions/runs/26179466871

## Proposed fix

Change the self-approval agent invocation from:

```yaml
permission_mode: approve-reads
```

to:

```yaml
permission_mode: approve-all
```

while keeping the workflow/job GitHub token permissions read-only for the agent step. This widens only the ACPX tool-approval mode so the agent can run the read-only `gh`/`git` inspection commands required by the prompt; it should not grant repository write capability to the agent.

## Acceptance criteria

- `agent-self-approve.yml` uses `permission_mode: approve-all` for the `run-agent-task` step.
- GitHub workflow permissions for the self-approval job remain read-only except for OIDC (`actions: read`, `contents: read`, `pull-requests: read`, `id-token: write`).
- Regression tests that assert the self-approval workflow contract are updated.
- A rerun of downstream self-approval can inspect `gh pr view` / `gh pr diff` and no longer blocks solely due to refused read-only terminal commands.

## Related note

The same downstream run also logged a non-fatal thread-state push failure (`Write access to repository not granted`). That appears separate from the ACPX command refusal and may be a transient GitHub/auth-write issue or expected when track-only state persistence is attempted with a read-only token. It did not directly cause the self-approval verdict, but logs could be clarified if needed.
title: Self-approval agent cannot inspect PR diffs under approve-reads
